source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Table 6.1.1 (p. 480) categories; Table 6.2.17 (p. 616) seismic importance; Table 6.2.9 (p. 601) wind importance

I.description: Low hazard to human life on failure (agricultural, minor storage)

II.description: Standard occupancy (all buildings not in I, III or IV)

III.description: Substantial hazard: assembly, schools, health care without surgery

IV.description: Essential facilities: hospitals, fire and police stations, shelters
